label: FGFR3::TACC3

sections.text: FGFR3 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
TACC3 encodes a coiled-coil protein involved in mitotic-spindle organization.

The fusion retains the FGFR kinase domain and the TACC coiled-coil region, promoting constitutive kinase activity and abnormal mitotic-spindle function. Transforming activity has been demonstrated in glioma models.
FGFR inhibition has shown activity in experimental fusion-positive glioma models; this preclinical evidence does not establish an approved glioma indication.

In adults with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma, a susceptible FGFR3 alteration such as FGFR3::TACC3 can support erdafitinib treatment after at least one prior systemic therapy. The US label does not recommend erdafitinib before PD-1/PD-L1 therapy in eligible patients. This indication does not cover glioma.
